gloss: what?!; what did you say?; you don't say!

definitions.gloss: what?!; what did you say?; you don't say!
definitions.explanation: Colloquial expression used to express surprise at something just heard, or to ask someone to repeat what they said. The surprise can be genuine shock, disbelief, or simply not having caught what was said.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧したって。」「{何|なん}だって？⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧？」
え、{何|なん}だって？⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Huh, what? Please say that again.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{延|の}びた→延びる：19599_nobiru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。」「{何|なん}だって！⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。」
examples.english: "The exam was pushed back to next week." "What?! That's a relief."

notes:
Casual expression combining なん (what) + だ (copula) + ⟦って→って：29146_tte⟧ (hearsay/quotation particle, here serving as an exclamatory marker). Used both to ask for repetition and to express surprise.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- え？: huh?; what? — neutral surprise or mishearing
- なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: what!; how surprising — more formal/literary
- ⟦まさか→まさか：03732_masaka⟧: no way; you're kidding — stronger disbelief
- うそ: no way; seriously? — casual disbelief
